parameters.name: AddressType
parameters.description:
The type of the IPv6 address. Valid values:

* IPv6Address (default): queries IPv6 instances with a single IPv6 IP address.
* IPv6Prefix: queries IPv6 instances with a prefix CIDR block.

parameters.name: AssociatedInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID associated with the IPv6 address that you want to query.

parameters.name: AssociatedInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the instance associated with the IPv6 address that you want to query. Valid values:

 - **EcsInstance**: an ECS instance in a VPC.
- **NetworkInterface**: a secondary elastic network interface (ENI) that serves as a network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include renewal data that has not taken effect. Valid values:

- **false** (default): does not include renewal data that has not taken effect.

- **true**: includes renewal data that has not taken effect.

parameters.name: Ipv6Address
parameters.description: The IPv6 address that you want to query.

parameters.name: Ipv6AddressId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 address that you want to query. You can specify up to 20 IPv6 address IDs in each call. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: Ipv6InternetBandwidthId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Internet bandwidth associated with the IPv6 address that you want to query. This parameter is available after public network bandwidth is enabled.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the IPv6 address that you want to query.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The communication type of the IPv6 address that you want to query. Valid values:

- **Private**: private communication.

- **Public**: public communication.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the IPv6 addresses that you want to query. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the IPv6 gateway belongs.

parameters.name: ServiceManaged
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the instance is a managed instance. Valid values:
- **true**: The instance is a managed instance.
- **false**: The instance is not a managed instance.

If you do not set this parameter, all instances are queried.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

A tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch to which the IPv6 address that you want to query belongs.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the IPv6 address that you want to query belongs.
